description: A serene primary bedroom bathed in soft, diffused natural light flooding in through a centered multi-pane window flanked by floor-length linen curtains in pale grey, hung from matte black rod hardware. The vaulted ceiling soars to a peak and is clad in white-painted shiplap planks, crossed by natural honey-toned exposed wood beams that converge symmetrically toward the window wall. Paneled walls in a soft grey-green hue frame the right side, adding quiet architectural texture without competing with the room's airy palette. The bed anchors the space, featuring a tall woven rattan headboard and a matching woven rattan base; crisp white quilted bedding is layered with an assortment of linen and textured throw pillows in cream, sage, and soft grey. To the left of the bed, a sculptural white plaster side table holds a small vase with fresh white blooms. A black-framed open-arm slipper chair with a cream linen cushion sits in the left foreground corner, accompanied by a soft diffused warm glow near the small side table surface. The flooring is wide-plank pale oak beneath a large faded vintage-style area rug in ivory and pale blue tones. A white painted nightstand is visible at the far right edge. The overall atmosphere is calm, airy, and subtly coastal-meets-farmhouse with a restrained warm-neutral palette. Camera is at standing eye-level, centered and level, offering a wide establishing symmetrical view straight down the room's long axis toward the window wall, capturing both side walls, the full vaulted ceiling, and the entire bed.
